parameters.name: CaSn
parameters.description:
The SN of the CA certificate to which the device certificate belongs. The SN uniquely identifies a CA certificate.

The value can be up to 128 bytes in length.

parameters.name: DeviceSn
parameters.description: The serial number (SN) of the device certificate that you want to inactivate. The SN uniquely identifies a device certificate.

parameters.name: MqttInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance to which the device certificate is attached.
